checks.name: count-body-identical
checks.detail: Complete count implementation is byte-identical to db52aedb.

checks.name: query-before-group-identical
checks.detail: Scope and dependency registration are preserved.

checks.name: query-after-group-identical
checks.detail: Limit, common epoch, cursors, row validation/dedup, overlay and global sort are byte-identical.

checks.name: all-original-test-source-preserved
checks.detail: Removing only new imports, new cases and additive assertions reconstructs the exact original complete test file, including every original fixture/assertion/30s deadline.

checks.name: protocol-rust-config-source-unchanged
checks.detail: No protocol/Rust/bridge/worker/deadline/owner changes; both workflows remain the prior cold-probe implementation.

checks.name: wire-encoded-utf8-json-budget
checks.detail: The key is encoded through encodeWireKey, JSON-stringified, then UTF8-counted. List starts at 2 bytes, adds comma only after first key, and resets after group publication.

checks.name: oversized-singleton-admission
checks.detail: Flush condition requires a nonempty group; a single over-budget key is accepted, then separated from subsequent keys. Existing bridge request transfer remains authoritative.

checks.name: count-key-cap
checks.detail: Flush occurs at QUERY_PAGE_SIZE = 256 before adding the next key. Empty anyOf yields no groups and no rows.

checks.name: dedup-and-global-limit
checks.detail: Typed key dedup is unchanged. Every group contributes rows keyed by primary identity; original global comparator and reverse apply after overlay, then readonly limit. Top-k-per-group remains sufficient for global top-k.

checks.name: epoch-authority
checks.detail: Common epoch lives outside group/page loops. Actual native table guard may reject a changed epoch before a second response; new test checks two attempts, conflict, one callback and staged rollback.

checks.name: rw-overlay
checks.detail: RW reads do not push limit. Original dependency is retained once; staged removal, index changes and insertions are reconciled before collection filtering/limit.

checks.name: positive-and-negative-evidence
checks.detail: Actual 71-case real-probe focused receipt is green. Retained original source plus additive byte assertion fails at 43,732,895 > 4,194,304; no raised timeout or reduced fixture.

checks.name: knip-authority
checks.detail: Previously independently checked exact config, real root caller traces, root+desktop quality and disposable-copy unused-export/removal negative failures. No suppression or source widening.

checks.name: spec-sync
checks.detail: Two new spec sections correctly state real wire bytes, singleton admission, count preservation, full frozen lanes and separate root/desktop Knip authority.
